audience: field service businesses who schedule jobs and technicians in Kickserv

useCases.title: See which jobs are scheduled for a period
useCases.text: The AI lists jobs by schedule window, status, assigned employee or job type, and opens one job with its customer, employees, charges and notes.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their jobs
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer, then lists their jobs with statuses and the notes on the customer.

useCases.title: Check employees and time logged on a job
useCases.text: The AI lists employees, active and inactive, and the time entries (hours logged by technicians) on a job.

useCases.title: Create a job or estimate for a customer
useCases.text: The AI looks up the customer, creates a job (work order) or an estimate for them, and can add a charge from your price list.

useCases.title: Update a job or add a note
useCases.text: The AI changes a job's schedule, description, category or assigned employees, or adds a note to a job or a customer.

useCases.title: Log hours worked on a job
useCases.text: The AI logs the hours an employee worked on a job.
